title: VERIFY cluster 2 (constitutional docs versus shipped code): INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md v1 and PRECEDENT.md v1, drift-checked against the real commands
description: Verdict T-356 and T-357 together, because they were written concurrently by different producers and concurrently with the code they describe - so the two interesting failures are (1) drift between a document and the shipped binary and (2) inconsistency between the two documents themselves. This verifier consumes the shipped CLI (T-353, T-354) because the drift check is not a reading exercise: for every behavior a document claims, you run the real command. Rotation slot 2: your identity must have produced no artifact in this epic, must not be `verifier-final`, and must differ from the identities executing T-359, T-361 and T-362.
acceptance_criteria: COMPLETENESS AGAINST THE SYNTHESIS: every IC-NN rule fixed in docs/precedent-research/synthesis-v1-requirements.md appears in INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md with the correct class (translation | preference | procedure), and no rule appears that the synthesis did not fix. Produce the id-by-id table in your verdict. A missing rule or an invented rule is a REJECT of T-356.

DRIFT IS THE POINT: for every behavior PRECEDENT.md v1 or INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md claims of the CLI - a flag, an exit code, a refusal, a rendered line - RUN THE REAL COMMAND and compare. Any mismatch is a REJECT naming the exact document section and the exact observed behavior. Do not accept a paraphrase as agreement.

CROSS-CONSISTENCY BETWEEN THE TWO DOCUMENTS: verify PRECEDENT.md references INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md by document name and version only, never by an IC-NN id it could not have known while writing concurrently - and if it does quote an IC-NN id, that id must actually exist in the shipped INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md or it is a REJECT. Verify INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md references PRECEDENT.md by section heading, never by line number. Verify neither document restates a rule the other owns.

CITATION HYGIENE, checked with grep, not by reading: both documents cite the addendum by DOI 10.22201/iij.24487937e.2026.20.20316 plus section. NEITHER tracked file may contain a docs/serenissima-addendum path citation - docs/ is gitignored (.gitignore:33) so such a citation would dangle for every reader who clones the repo. Also grep both files for absolute user paths and sibling-project names: this is a public repo and T-348 found exactly this class of leak as a commit blocker.

LINE-CITE ROT SWEEP: check every file:line and file:section citation in both documents and report every one that no longer resolves. T-346 recorded a stale cite at PRECEDENT.md:36 plus five path citations the layer's own token resolver flags as dangling; T-357 was charged with repairing the ones inside its own file, so confirm each was actually repaired rather than reworded.

CONTENT FLOOR, checked section by section: all six of T-357's named sections exist and say what they were charged to say. Specifically verify: (a) the corrective path is stated to require SOURCES and correction without sources is stated to be INVALID; (b) valuation is stated to be METATEXTUAL - it changes force, not meaning; (c) graded force is explicitly distinguished from authority_tier as issuance authority, and the statement that a single verdicted decision still binds is present (the floor is preserved, only the ceiling moves); (d) decay is stated to FLAG reconsideration candidates and NEVER to auto-expire; (e) the fact-re-description constraint requires stating WHICH material facts differ and WHY the difference is material; (f) the no-collective-intent rule is present and the disposition-versus-norm and second-degree-document framing is stated. A section that exists but hedges the rule into non-operativity is a REJECT.

THE HONESTY CHECK ON INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md: confirm the document states that it does NOT eliminate indeterminacy (structural: vagueness, ambiguity, unforeseen contexts, competing methods, competing background theories) and that its payoff is making divergence AUDITABLE via three distinguishable failure modes. A document promising determinacy misstates its own theory and is a REJECT.

MACHINE-READABLE VERSION: confirm INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md declares its version in the exact form and location the synthesis fixed, and demonstrate it by extracting the version string with a one-line command in your verdict. A version a CLI cannot read cannot be cited by a record's interpretive_code_version field.

NO EMOJIS in either document: scan every character above U+2100 and report what you find (mathematical and typographic symbols are notation, not emojis - say which you found and why it is not a violation).

VERDICT T-356 and T-357 INDIVIDUALLY via `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py update <T-ID> --status done --agent <you> --note "..."`, or `--status open` with a REJECTED: note naming the exact document section and observed behavior. RECORD YOUR REVIEWER IDENTITY and confirm in writing that you are not `verifier-final`, produced no artifact in this epic, and are not the identity that executed T-359.
